# Pinned on purpose. This workflow runs on a schedule, so an unpinned dependency means a
# fresh upstream release can break a build in which nothing in this repo changed. That is
# exactly what happened on 2026-09-03: lxml published 6.1.3's sdist ~21h before its cp38
# wheels, the cron run landed in the gap, and pip fell back to a source build that failed.
#
# Bump these deliberately (Dependabot opens a PR weekly), never implicitly.
python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0
requests==2.34.2
lxml==6.1.3
